title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, requesting authority from the Department, pursuant to Chapter 164, Section 75C for right to exercise the power of eminent domain under Chapter 79 of the G.L. for the right to take by eminent domain such rights of way, permanent easements, temporary, easements or such other interests to land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration and/or removal of natural gas transmission pipelines, appliances, appurtenances and other equipment situated in the Towns of Bolton and Clinton in the County of Worcester.
